method: fresh official-source retest before accepting remaining open status

confirmed: The municipality directs applicants to perform the Vergunningcheck in Omgevingsloket and submit the omgevingsvergunning through Omgevingsloket.
A concept request can be submitted through the same Omgevingsloket flow for complex plans or plans outside the omgevingsplan.
The regular decision period is in principle 8 weeks; the extensive procedure is 26 weeks; the municipality can extend once by 6 weeks.
2026 fees are activity-specific and must be taken from the current Tarieventabel leges rather than encoded as one generic housing amount.

Baarn's current Bibob information confirms that a Bibob investigation can apply to an application for a permit for regular residential letting in a designated area or accommodation for labour migrants; a Bibob investigation can also sometimes apply to an omgevingsvergunning building application.

confirmed: If land or a building is to be used differently from what the omgevingsplan allows, the municipality directs the applicant to submit the request through Omgevingsloket.
For building permit applications the municipality states that a building plan must be submitted; it consists of a description of the work and usually includes a drawing or floor plan.

The current 2026-2030 coalition agreement explicitly states that Barendrecht sees opportunities in adding homes by topping-up or splitting existing dwellings and supports such initiatives under conditions; this is policy context, not itself the permit rule.
The current municipal sitemap exposes the live Omgevingsplan and building/permit product routes; no separate static ordinary-room-rental checklist was found in this retest.
